fut.text: Theros appears in the timeline as the place where Elspeth Tirel's spark ignited at thirteen and where Heliod later killed her in Nyx.

ths.text: On Theros, a plane ruled by gods and filled with heroes and monsters, Elspeth planeswalked in from New Phyrexia and was restored by the snake priests of Pharika, then killed a deadly hydra and won Heliod's notice.

Heliod made Elspeth his champion after she slew Polukranos, turning her blade into the spear Godsend, but Xenagos, whose spark had ignited and taken him from Theros, returned and resolved to enter the pantheon as a god.

Xenagos attacked the poleis with otherworldly monsters, which blinded the gods and led Kruphix to enact the Silence of the Gods, and he then ascended through a forced Great Revel while Elspeth was scapegoated and exiled.

When Elspeth offered her life for Daxos, Heliod fatally wounded his former champion, but her Shadowspear was acknowledged as the true Khrusor, Heliod's spear shattered, and Erebos imprisoned Heliod in the Underworld forever.

bng.text: Xenagos returned to Theros to become the god of revels, and his rituals blurred the line between Nyx and the mortal world, so that Nyxborn creatures poured into the mortal realm.

The gods blamed each other for the chaos and sent ferocious Nyxborn against mortals, while Mogis sent hordes of minotaurs against Akros, Meletis and Setessa; Elspeth was blamed for Xenagos's ascension and driven into the wilderness.
In Akros, Leandros asked why the gods had abandoned them, and Mnesos answered that the gods had retreated into Nyx before, while Heliod began preparing a way to restore the proper order.

jou.text: After the Great Revel the gods swore vengeance against human civilization, and Elspeth fled into the wilderness, barely escaping Heliod's wrath.

In one city's dream, the city awakened as Cacophony, god of cities, until Ephara drained its life, while Ashiok's nightmares spread so that magic users woke with no memory of what they had done and were cast out.
Elspeth went on to strike down Xenagos in Nyx, but Heliod, afraid of her power, killed her with her own weapon.

ori.text: On Theros's seas, Kiora summoned an armada of sea-beasts from many worlds against Thassa, who sent Elspeth and Ajani away on a great wave.
Kiora tried to wrest the kraken Arixmethes from Thassa and failed, then her serpent and half her krakens turned on her, and Thassa pinned her to a boulder with the thrown bident.
Kiora took the bident and planeswalked away with it, leaving Thassa crying out in anguish.

mh1.text: Theros appears on this set's cards as the plane with the stronghold of Heliod's light.

thb.text: In Theros Beyond Death, Elspeth drowned in the Underworld until her spark reignited, and she pulled Heliod's spear from a nightmare and turned it into Shadowspear.

With Shadowspear acknowledged as the true Khrusor, Heliod yielded and Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld, and Klothys, furious that souls were reversing their deaths, sent the Agent of Fate Calix after Elspeth.
Elsewhere on the plane, Ashiok's nightmares manifested in reality until Elspeth's Shadowspear drove Ashiok away, and Klothys set out to mend the destiny of Theros.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Daxos fought in defense of Theros and the invasion was repelled.

m21.text: Theros appears on this set's cards as the plane whose destiny Klothys sets out to mend.
